_how: Recipe for shorts.build (video-machine). 15 clips from the 2026-10-06 solo episode (take 144723, the full retake). keep = word-index ranges of 02_audio/words/144723.json, inclusive, in play order; fillers (um/uh) skip automatically; fixes = word index -> caption text. approved = Ashley approved the edit, title and description for publishing. Caption-hidden words (fixes "") stay in the audio: cutting them would clip the words beside them. TikTok catch-up (2026-11-04): every TikTok part of these Shorts failed Oct 14..20 (the chapter track), so each clip's "tiktok_catchup" is a TikTok-only post of its own, kept out of "metricool" so social.shorts and Ops never touch the clip's other, already-posted networks. Its media is 05_exports/shorts/tiktok-cover/<id>.mp4: the approved render with the clip's cover as frame one, which TikTok shows as the cover.

youtube.title: A $1,200 pump-out with a $500 coupon: should you copy it?
youtube.description:
